diagnosis: HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements per the FISH addendum of 19 Sep 2026 (DLBCL/HGBL-MYC/BCL2 in WHO 5th edition); the initial report of DLBCL NOS no longer applies. Germinal centre phenotype (Hans).
stage: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage IIA with bulk (12 cm anterior mediastinal mass plus right neck nodes), nothing below the diaphragm and no extranodal sites.
biology: FISH: MYC rearranged, BCL2 rearranged, BCL6 rearrangement not detected (BCL6 not rearranged; FISH negative for BCL6), so double-hit rather than triple-hit. MYC/BCL2 protein co-expression (double-expressor) is present but is superseded by the rearrangement-based classification.
prognosis: IPI score of 1 (elevated LDH only), which understates risk; the genetics drive a poor prognosis.
first_line_treatment: Cancel the R-CHOP planned before the FISH result. Treat with DA-EPOCH-R x 6 cycles with curative intent; a clinical trial is an equally reasonable choice if open. Radiation therapy to residual mediastinal disease after chemotherapy, to be discussed at tumor board.
cns_risk: Although the CNS-IPI is low (1), the CNS risk is high because of the double-hit genetics. Obtain gadolinium MRI of the brain and an LP for CSF cytology and flow before starting. Give intrathecal methotrexate with DA-EPOCH-R as CNS prophylaxis.
response_assessment: PET-CT after cycle 2 and an end-of-treatment PET-CT scored by Deauville (Lugano 2014).
pretreatment_workup: HBV serologies negative (HBsAg-, anti-HBc-). Echo with LVEF 60% allows doxorubicin.
supportive_care: TLS risk intermediate: allopurinol, IV fluids, TLS labs twice daily for cycle 1. Filgrastim support with every cycle. The new port will carry the 96-hour infusion. Discuss sperm cryopreservation. Watch for SVC syndrome or airway symptoms and give return precautions.
fitness_and_goals: Good candidate for intensive therapy (54 years, ECOG 1, normal heart, kidney and liver function); wants cure.
